notes: Pass 1: eight own pages read, all HTTP 200; the App Marketplace directory renders by script and its fetch snapshot is thin, as was the one individual integration page tried (Sage 300 CRE). Three cited pages were read for causes: projul.com (C09) and pmspace.ai (C10) carry the statements; fieldservicesoftware.io does not carry C10. C03 merges plain products-based pricing with the 'separate paid modules' lines, because the pricing page charges by product. Hedged lines (for example 'can come with a heavy six-figure annual price tag', 'could easily hit $30,000 to $40,000/year') were not coded; name mentions such as 'Procore Platform' and review ratings were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct): both pages in needs_browser_read were read once in a real browser. The Sage 300 CRE listing settles C28 (now true). The marketplace directory browser snapshot shows only five spotlight apps, so it settles nothing. Under the clarification's two-integration-page allowance, the Procore-built Viewpoint Vista connector listing (its URL taken from the already-read marketplace HTML) was fetched once, the 13th of 14 reads; it is thin but carries the listing title, so C29 is now true. Consistency check: C09 (no pricing page) and C10 (per-user pricing) stay wrong; both contradictions are on procore.com/pricing and compare like with like. Added: the q7 Google AI Mode 1 'tailored quote' line to C01 and the q7 Claude 3 table cell 'QuickBooks/Xero Integration ... Requires add-ons' to C31 and C32; other gap and table lines are already covered from the same answers (C01, C02, C03, C13) or out of scope (fit, features, other vendors). Reviewer: look first at C29, which rests on a thin snapshot carrying only the listing title.
